description:
Bypass of every gate. protected.py:34-41 and :304-311 check settings with a text regex and only under home. These writes pass:
1. ~/.claude/settings.json with "agent-discipline-watcher@agent-discipline-watcher": false (plugin name still present).
2. "disableAllHooks": true.
3. "env": {"ADW_ALLOW_PROTECTED_EDIT": "1"}.
4. project .claude/settings.local.json or settings.json with 2 or 3.

Fix: parse the JSON. Block when enabledPlugins sets the ADW plugin to anything but true, when disableAllHooks is true, or when env sets ADW_ALLOW_PROTECTED_EDIT. Apply to user and project .claude/settings*.json. Unparseable JSON keeps the current behavior.

Acceptance: the four writes block; an unrelated settings edit passes. Tests by adw-test-writer.
title: Block settings writes that switch ADW off
